source_node_id.description: The surface item c7 could not decide. Not only service methods: a screen whose row source could not be resolved, or a navigation rule whose target is computed, reaches this step the same way.

method_name.description: Present only when source_node_id is an SVC node.

resolution.description: mapped: an operation was produced. no_endpoint: this legitimately has no HTTP surface (an internal helper reached only by another service). client_side_only: the replacement needs no server round-trip for it — the usual answer for a navigation rule or a display-only condition. needs_human_contract: could not be decided, and blocks c9's gate rather than shipping a guess.

operation.description: Required when resolution is 'mapped'; absent otherwise.

reasoning.description: Why this shape was chosen — specifically why the method is or is not CRUD-shaped, and which convention rule was applied. Recorded in the pack so the judgment is auditable rather than anonymous.
